title: FFmpeg 1.0.0
release_notes:
• Full FFmpeg 8 engine via PyAV — convert, transcode & compress with exact target sizes
• Frame-accurate trimming with a live trim range and instant stream-copy cuts
• Audio Studio: two-pass LUFS mastering, channel routing, sample-rate conversion
• Extract audio, frames and palette-optimized GIFs; media dossier with live engine probe
• Serial job queue with per-job progress, cancel, and swipe-undo history
• On-device capture, filters, and batch tools — your media never leaves your phone
